appointment_values.name: appointment_values
appointment_values.value: "appointments"."revision">0 and "appointments"."ends_at">"appointments"."starts_at" and "appointments"."duration_minutes" between 5 and 480 and "appointments"."duration_minutes"%5=0 and "appointments"."status" in ('confirmed','cancelled','completed','no_show') and "appointments"."source" in ('voice','owner','owner_test')

overrides_values.name: overrides_values
overrides_values.value: ("availability_overrides"."kind"='closed' and "availability_overrides"."start" is null and "availability_overrides"."end" is null) or ("availability_overrides"."kind"='open' and "availability_overrides"."start" is not null and "availability_overrides"."end" is not null and "availability_overrides"."start"<"availability_overrides"."end")

customer_values.name: customer_values
customer_values.value: "customers"."revision">0 and length(trim("customers"."name"))>0 and ("customers"."phone_e164" is not null or "customers"."email" is not null) and ("customers"."phone_e164" is null or "customers"."phone_e164" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') and ("customers"."email" is null or length(trim("customers"."email"))>0)

inquiry_values.name: inquiry_values
inquiry_values.value: "inquiries"."revision">0 and "inquiries"."type" in ('lead','callback') and "inquiries"."status" in ('new','in_progress','resolved') and length(trim("inquiries"."summary"))>0 and "inquiries"."source" in ('form','owner','voice')

policy_values.name: policy_values
policy_values.value: "scheduling_policies"."revision">0 and "scheduling_policies"."slot_minutes" in (5,10,15,30,60) and "scheduling_policies"."notice_minutes" between 0 and 10080 and "scheduling_policies"."horizon_days" between 1 and 180 and "scheduling_policies"."cutoff_minutes" between 0 and 10080

service_values.name: service_values
service_values.value: "services"."revision">0 and length(trim("services"."name"))>0 and "services"."duration_minutes" between 5 and 480 and "services"."duration_minutes"%5=0
